snippet.title: Fangstorm | Harvest of Terror: A Horror Game Awards Halloween Showcase 2026 Trailer
snippet.description:
Fangstorm on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4418500/Fangstorm/  You are the defense. One orc demigod against relentless goblin sieges. Fight in brutal first-person melee, unleash devastating abilities, and build kill zones. Use a deep, persistent progression system to turn yourself into a meat grinder forged by endless carnage. 
---
Originally aired during HARVEST OF TERROR: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Wednesday 7 October 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.

Website: https://thehorrorgameawards.com/
Merch: https://store.thehorrorgameawards.com/
Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/TheHorrorGameAwards
